narrative.details:
Wonderful, wonderful.

<Lotwil looks up at you for a moment before going back to his shackles.>

Go speak to Lucien, adventurer. I need a cog #5. Bring it to me, will you?
narrative.objectives: Speak to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Cog #5, huh? Yeah, this isn't going to be good.
